response_capture: 60 s maximum input-clock silence; retain 19.2 s checkpoint and final-frame speech flags; native termination metadata is recorded, never assumed.

chunking.rule: Use the first observed sentence boundary at or after 25 s; otherwise close at 40 s. Do not query on empty chunks; do not close on tiny filler turns.

evaluation_gate: Pilot and held-out scoring checks precede full-bank inference; model failures remain legitimate outcomes after caller qualification.
reference_inputs: Past speaker-attributed transcript; draft answer hidden from first proposer.
amortized_inputs: Past transcript, previous saved results and fixed goal only; no future user question.
primary_metric: Source-supported complete answer correctness; three ordinal judge dimensions remain diagnostics.
thinking_tokens: Only native request-time thinking tokens; Instruct unexposed thinking is N/A, ordinary output separate.
history: Retain all available history; record capacity failures and any explicit fallback, never silently trim.
S2_notes_budget: Instruct: 2048 total generated tokens per earlier call; Thinking: 8192 native thinking plus note tokens per earlier call; compact final notes, all actual compute recorded.
S2_request_budget: Instruct 2048; Thinking 16384 native reasoning plus final output; native reasoning not forced for Instruct.
S1_prompts: A fixed question-blind meeting instruction for MiniCPM and DuplexOmni; original native control prompt retained; Moshi native interface has no system-text prompt.
source_audio_attribution: AMI corpus audio; existing source/copy and licensing records in the question audio library; synthetic question audio and generated model speech are labeled separately.
reference_input_correction: The audio-enrollment word list omits untimed words and must not be used as a complete text oracle. Corrected Earnings21 chunks preserve all words with conservative release; all 382 cited source passages now match. AMI pilot inputs are unchanged.
